_why: Shield's reaction reads the slots through refresh_slot_left and spends through spend_lowest_slot, so a Warlock who holds it (no class list gives it one yet: a feat, a race or an item would) spends a pact slot. Before, it checked the wizard pools only, so a held Shield was dropped on the first hit and never fired. The brute's swing lands inside the +5, so Shield turns it into a miss and one of the two 2nd-level pact slots is spent.
